output.title: Mobile app push notifications not arriving
output.content: If push notifications aren't arriving on mobile, first check that notifications are allowed for the app in your phone's OS-level settings (Settings > Notifications on iOS, or App info > Notifications on Android). In-app notification toggles only work if OS-level permission is also granted.

output.title: Exporting reports to PDF (macOS)
output.content: On macOS, the in-app 'Export to PDF' button can crash the app on some versions. Workaround: use File > Print, then choose 'Save as PDF' from the system print dialog instead of the in-app export button. A permanent fix is planned but not yet released.

output.title: Supported browsers
output.content: The web app officially supports the latest two versions of Chrome, Firefox, Edge, and Safari. Internet Explorer is not supported. Some layout issues may appear on unsupported browsers.

output.title: Adding and removing team members
output.content: Admins can add or remove team members from Account Settings > Team. Removing a member immediately revokes their access; there is no confirmation delay. Each member's role (Admin, Editor, Viewer) can be changed from the same screen.

output.title: Account locked — suspicious activity flag
output.content: If your account was locked due to a suspicious-activity flag (unusual location, new device, or an admin-triggered security hold), it cannot be unlocked by resetting your password. You must contact support directly so an agent can verify your identity manually before restoring access.

steps.rawOutput:
Thanks for reporting this. Even though you've enabled notifications in the app, Android requires that notification permissions also be granted at the phone's system level for them to arrive.

Please check your Android phone's settings by going to **App info > Notifications** and make sure notifications are allowed for our app there. The in-app notification toggle only works if the OS-level permission is also granted.

Once you've verified that setting, notifications should start coming through. Let me know if you continue to experience issues after checking your phone's system settings.
